chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Marwak ibn Ubayd, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, when the elder Yaqub (peace be upon him) came to Yusuf (peace be upon him), the might of kingship entered him, so he did not descend to (welcome) him. So Jibra'il (peace be upon him) descended and said: 'O Yusuf! Extend your palm.' So a shining light came out from it and became in the atmosphere of the sky. So Yusuf said: 'O Jibra'il, what is this light which came out from my palm?' So he said: 'Prophet-hood has been removed from your descendants as a punishment for what caused you not to descend to the elder Yaqub, so there will not be a prophet from your descendants.'
ai.seo_question: Why was prophethood removed from the descendants of Prophet Yusuf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this incident highlights the distinction between the dignity of prophethood and the obligation of filial piety, where Yusuf's temporary withholding of descent was a test of humility rather than a permanent loss of status. The removal of prophethood from his direct line underscores the principle that neglecting the rights of parents can sever spiritual lineage, a theme frequently cited by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to illustrate the gravity of *adab* (etiquette) before God.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Marwak Bin Ubeyd, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Yusuf<sup>as</sup> was such that when the elderly Yaqoub<sup>as</sup> proceeded to him<sup>as</sup>, the might of the kingship entered into him<sup>as</sup> and he<sup>as</sup> did not dismount to (welcome) him<sup>as</sup>. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descended and said: ‘O Yusuf<sup>as</sup>! Extend your<sup>as</sup> palm!’. So a shining light came out from it and came to be in the atmosphere of the sky. So Yusuf<sup>as</sup> said: ‘What is this light which came out from my<sup>as</sup> palm?’ So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘The Prophet-hood has been Removed from your<sup>as</sup> children as a Punishment to what caused you<sup>as</sup> not to descend to the elderly Yaqoub<sup>as</sup>, therefore there will not happen to be a Prophet<sup>as</sup> from your<sup>as</sup> children’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Marwak ibn ‘Ubayd from those narrated to him from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Joseph, Yusuf, peace be upon him, met his old father, Ya’qub and because of majestic feeling of a king he did not dismount. Jibril (Gabriel) descended to him and said, ‘O Yusuf (look on) your palm.’ A shining light came out and went into the sky. Joseph asked, ‘O Jibril (Gabriel), what was that light that came out of my palm?’ He said, ‘Prophet-hood was removed from your descendents as punishment for not dismounting to the old Ya’qub, thus, there will be no prophet in your descendents.’”
